first.rationale: Competitor entry pricing creates an immediate risk to price-sensitive SMB acquisition, and prior evidence indicates targeted promotional pricing lifted both qualified acquisition and revenue while improving time-to-first-value across billing plans. I would verify that result and compare its durability and segment definitions against the onboarding evidence before committing. Pricing should remain targeted and be evaluated for discount dependency, margin dilution, and post-promotion retention, since the objective is sustainable long-term qualified revenue rather than short-term volume.
